description: BitTuitive pays a scoreboard-verified L402 API and returns its data plus routing metadata — use this when the data you need is on another paid API. Price: upstream price + fee (max(20%, 3 sats)); the 402 body shows the all-in amount. Sample (illustrative, not live): {"data":{"note":"The upstream API's JSON body is returned here unchanged."},"routing":{"routed_by":"BitTuitive L402 router","upstream":{"endpoint_id":"example-id","name":"Example L402 API","host":"example.com","data_type":"bitcoin","score":92},"paid_sats":15,"upstream_price_sats":10,"fee_sats":5,"fallback_used":false}} Pay: Call it, get HTTP 402 (or MCP payment_required) with a Lightning invoice and macaroon, pay the invoice, then retry with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. x402 (USDC) is not available for this payment yet (routed calls and subscriptions); use L402. Give endpoint_id (from route_endpoints) OR data_type and/or q (best pick, with fallback). If status is 'running', repeat the same call with the same l402_credential.

credit.description: Credit token from a failed routed call (instead of paying).

l402_credential.description: Optional L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (or 'L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>') from a paid invoice or an active subscription. Omit it to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

params.description: Optional query parameters forwarded to the upstream API.

q.description: Keywords for best-pick mode, e.g. 'air quality'.

name: route_call
title: Call any verified L402 API through BitTuitive (paid, L402)
